name: pgAdmin 4
product: pgAdmin 4 by the pgAdmin Development Team

evidence.says: The pgAdmin team lists 9.19 as the current macOS release and distributes separate builds for Intel and Apple Silicon.
The PostgreSQL versioned download directory lists pgadmin4-9.19-arm64.dmg alongside an x64 disk image.

name: E-Devlet E-Imza Uygulaması
product: e-Devlet e-İmza Uygulaması, the e-signature login component of Türkiye’s e-Devlet Kapısı, operated by Türksat

evidence.says: The e-Devlet help center describes a Java Web Start application launched from the portal to sign in or use services requiring an electronic signature.

notes: The scanned com.oracle.jnlp identifier refers to the portal’s Java Web Start launcher wrapper.

name: Pixave
product: Pixave for Mac by LittleHJ (YoungHo Kim)

evidence.says: The developer’s Mac App Store release notes explicitly identify Pixave 2.3.13 as a universal app with native Apple Silicon and Intel builds.
The developer lists 2.3.13 as the latest release, dated November 23, 2020, and gives separate minimum macOS versions for Intel and Apple Silicon.

name: PixelStick
product: Classic PixelStick by Plum Amazing

evidence.says: Plum Amazing lists Original PixelStick 2.16.4 as a maintenance download and says it uses Rosetta.
The official update feed names release 2.16.4 and dates it October 2, 2025 in the feed's timezone.
Inspection of PixelStick.app/Contents/MacOS/PixelStick in the official ZIP found only x86_64 and its Info.plist confirmed 2.16.4 and the listing bundle ID.

notes: The vendor's feature matrix also labels the classic app universal, which the inspected executable contradicts. PixelStick Pro is a separate product with a different bundle ID.

name: 4K YouTube to MP3
product: 4K YouTube to MP3 by Open Media LLC (4K Download)

evidence.says: The vendor lists separate Apple Silicon and Intel macOS installers for 4K YouTube to MP3 26.4.0.0406, both dated November 11, 2026.

name: Cornerstone
product: Cornerstone Subversion client by Zennaware, now distributed by Assembla

evidence.says: Assembla provides the 4.2 download as the current Cornerstone version and older releases as the same product.
Assembla announced Cornerstone 4.2 on December 31, 2019.
The official 4.2 package identifies itself as com.zennaware.cornerstone3 and its main executable Cornerstone.app/Contents/MacOS/Cornerstone is x86_64 only.
Homebrew identifies the same 4.2 package as Intel and lists Rosetta 2 as required on Apple Silicon.

notes: Cornerstone 4.2 uses a different bundle ID from the scanned 2.x release.

name: WhatSize
product: WhatSize for Mac by ID-Design

evidence.says: The vendor’s release history identifies version 8.2.9 as the current release and dates it to August 31, 2026.
Inspection of WhatSize.app/Contents/MacOS/WhatSize inside this official 8.2.9 installer found a universal Mach-O with x86_64 and arm64 slices.

notes: The current WhatSize 8 app uses bundle ID com.id-design.v8.whatsize.

name: GainControl
product: GainControl by Speakerfood, a Logic Pro menu-bar utility

evidence.says: Speakerfood offers GainControl 1.5.11 dated November 19, 2024 under Legacy Products and states that Logic Pro 13 is unsupported.
The official package contains com.speakerfood.GainControl version 1.5.11, and its Applications/GainControl.app/Contents/MacOS/GainControl executable has arm64 and x86_64 slices.

notes: GainControl is a menu-bar application that operates on Logic Pro audio regions.

name: Zentraedi ZspaceMacApp
product: Zspace (极空间) NAS desktop client by Zspace (Zentraedi)

evidence.says: Zspace provides separate Mac desktop downloads for Apple M-series and Intel x86 chips.
The cask metadata ties com.zentraedi.zspaceMacApp to the vendor-hosted arm64 package for version 2.46.2026101501 and a separate x64 package.

notes: The aDrive and Alipay Key Tool cask hints refer to unrelated products.

name: DAirRegistration
product: Dainese D-air Registration desktop software for compatible D-air Road garments

evidence.says: Dainese links to the Mac desktop software for configuring and registering its compatible D-air Road garments.
The official Mac download resolves to the vendor's dair-registration-1.8.24-universal disk image.

limitation: The download's universal label was verified by HTTP metadata without inspecting the 188 MB image.
notes: The same Dainese page also describes a separate mobile app for newer garments.

name: KeyboardCleanTool
product: KeyboardCleanTool by Andreas Hegenberg (folivora.ai)

evidence.says: The vendor’s Sparkle feed lists 9.0 build 13, dated November 10, 2026, as the current release.
Inspection of KeyboardCleanTool.app/Contents/MacOS/KeyboardCleanTool in the official 9.0 ZIP found x86_64 and arm64 Mach-O slices, and the bundle plist matched com.hegenberg.KeyboardCleanTool.

name: Day of the Tentacle Remastered
product: Day of the Tentacle Remastered for macOS by Double Fine Productions

evidence.says: The Mac App Store lists version 1.7 as the latest Mac release and dates it to June 24, 2020.
A customer review of the same Mac App Store release reports that the game launches on an M1 Mac via Rosetta 2.
The publisher’s Steam listing specifies Intel Core-series processors in the macOS requirements.

limitation: No current binary was inspected, and the report covers an M1 Mac.
notes: This record covers the Mac release with bundle ID com.doublefine.dottosx and version 1.7 (shown as 1.70 in the historical scan). The iOS edition has a separate App Store entry.

name: CocoaMSX
product: CocoaMSX, Akop Karapetyan's open-source MSX emulator for macOS

evidence.says: The project marks CocoaMSX 1.61 as its latest official release.
The official disk image contains com.akop.CocoaMSX version 1.61, whose CocoaMSX.app/Contents/MacOS/CocoaMSX executable is x86_64 only.

limitation: No verified report of the official 1.61 binary running through Rosetta was found.

name: Tap Forms 5
product: Tap Forms Organizer 5 by Tap Zapp Software Inc.

evidence.says: The developer's Mac App Store listing says Tap Forms 5 requires Rosetta and dates version 5.3.45 to September 30, 2025.
Inspection of Tap Forms Mac 5.app/Contents/MacOS/Tap Forms Mac 5 found only x86_64, and the bundle metadata confirmed version 5.3.45 build 1910 and the listing bundle ID.

notes: The developer gives macOS 27 as the last supported macOS version and identifies Tap Forms Pro as the native successor.

name: EVE Launcher
product: Legacy EVE Online Launcher by CCP Games

evidence.says: CCP confirms that the new EVE Online launcher permanently replaced the old launcher on February 7, 2024.
CCP says the new launcher moved the macOS launcher from emulation to native Apple Silicon execution.

limitation: CCP does not identify the legacy launcher's final version or its executable slices in these announcements.
notes: The replacement EVE Online launcher is Apple Silicon native. This listing is for the old launcher.

name: Aria Maestosa
product: Aria Maestosa open-source MIDI sequencer and editor by the Aria Maestosa project

evidence.says: The project lists 1.4.13d as its stable 64-bit Mac download.
The project archive dates the 1.4.13d Mac package to November 7, 2020.
The official 1.4.13d archive contains org.AriaMaestosa and its Contents/MacOS/Aria Maestosa executable is x86_64 only.
Homebrew marks its 1.4.13d cask as requiring Rosetta and disabled for a Gatekeeper check failure.

limitation: The cask caveat identifies the translation requirement, but successful operation under Rosetta was not verified.
notes: The archive uses the release suffix d while the internal bundle version remains 1.4.13.

name: MacMediaKeyForwarder
product: Original MacMediaKeyForwarder by Milan Toth (Milgra)

evidence.says: Milgra’s original repository directs users to Quentin Lesceller’s fork for current versions and bug fixes.
A user quotes the original developer’s announcement that he stopped maintaining the app and invited a fork.
The original project's latest tagged release is 3.1, dated October 14, 2019.
Inspection of MacMediaKeyForwarder.app/Contents/MacOS/MacMediaKeyForwarder in Milgra’s 3.1 ZIP found only x86_64, and the bundle plist matched com.milgra.hsmke.
The separately maintained fork’s version 4.7.0 Xcode project specifies bundle ID com.quentinlesceller.macmediakeyforwarder.

limitation: Rosetta runtime compatibility for the original release was not verified.
notes: The similarly named Homebrew cask now targets Quentin Lesceller’s separately maintained fork, whose 4.7.0 project uses com.quentinlesceller.macmediakeyforwarder.

name: Runway
product: Runway desktop creative toolkit by Runway AI, Inc. (RunwayML)

evidence.says: Runway’s changelog lists desktop release 0.19.2 on September 22, 2021.
Inspection of Runway.app/Contents/MacOS/Runway in the official 0.19.2 DMG found an x86_64-only Mach-O, and the app plist matched com.runwayai.runway.
Homebrew identifies the current downloadable desktop package as 0.19.2 and says that it requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
Runway’s current getting-started guide directs users to its separate browser service.

limitation: The cask reports a Rosetta requirement, but I did not find vendor or firsthand confirmation that the legacy desktop client still operates with its online services.
notes: The modern Runway browser service and Celestial Teapot’s similarly named Mac utility are separate products.

name: Colloquy
product: Colloquy desktop IRC client by the Colloquy project

evidence.says: The project lists its July 3, 2021 build 7097 as a Mac prerelease and the latest Mac download it publishes on GitHub.
The official archive identifies Colloquy as info.colloquy, version 2.5 build 7097, and Colloquy.app/Contents/MacOS/Colloquy is x86_64 only.

limitation: Rosetta operation of the official 7097 download was not verified.
notes: The older 2.4.3 build is the stable release in the scan history, and the separate iOS App Store app is outside this record.

name: HiSuite
product: HiSuite for Mac by Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.

evidence.says: Huawei identifies 13.0.0.350 as the Mac version and sends Mac users to Apple's store.
The App Store lookup matches com.huawei.hisuite to version 13.0.0.350 and dates the App Store release to April 23, 2026.
The Mac App Store lists Huawei's release history and macOS compatibility without specifying its CPU architecture.

limitation: No explicit architecture or inspectable official package was found for this version.
notes: Huawei's support page labels the same App Store version with a later date, June 1, 2026.

name: KugouMusic
product: KuGou Music (酷狗音乐) for Mac by Guangzhou KuGou Technology Co., Ltd.

evidence.says: The developer lists KuGou Music for Mac version 20.3.8 and directs downloads to the Mac App Store.
Apple's lookup maps the current Mac listing to com.kugou.mac.Music and dates the App Store release of version 20.3.8 to September 14, 2026.
The vendor offers Intel and Apple-chip packages for its separate KuGou WAVE product and lists KuGou Music for Mac separately.

limitation: The Mac App Store release's executable architecture could not be confirmed.
notes: The vendor page lists September 10, 2026 for the same version.

name: InteleViewer
product: InteleViewer medical image viewer by Intelerad Medical Systems

evidence.says: Intelerad documents the Mac client and refers users to its service portal for installation requirements.
Pacific Radiology currently links to a Mac installer named InteleViewer-5-6-1-P189.dmg.
I-MED lists Intel and M1 processors in its InteleViewer Mac guidance without identifying the underlying executable architecture.

limitation: No architecture evidence was found for the current provider-distributed build, whose disk image is 214 MB.
notes: The named version is the Pacific Radiology distribution and may differ from versions provided by other PACS operators.

name: iramuteq
product: IRaMuTeQ by Pierre Ratinaud

evidence.says: The maintainer supplies separate Apple Silicon and Intel macOS downloads for release 0.8 alpha 7.
The project's official file listing dates the Apple Silicon archive to November 2, 2024.
Inspection of iramuteq-0.8a7-macOS-Mx.app/Contents/MacOS/iramuteq verified x86_64 and arm64 slices and confirmed the listing bundle ID.

notes: The official Apple Silicon download is labeled 0.8a7, while the app bundle still reports 0.0.0 internally. The vendor's installation instructions list Apple Silicon R for macOS 14 or later and XQuartz.

name: Disk Cartography
product: Disk Cartography – Clever Disk Space Analyzer by CleverFiles (508 Software)

evidence.says: The original product coverage identifies 508 Software and links to its Mac App Store listing with ID 905264208.
Apple's lookup returns no listing for the original App Store ID.
The original vendor link is live and promotes its separate Disk Drill product, with no Disk Cartography listing.

limitation: No formal retirement notice or architecture evidence for the final public build was found.
notes: The historical scanner submission identified version 1.40.

name: nextLAB Mobile
product: FotoKem nextLAB Mobile on-set dailies workstation software

evidence.says: FotoKem describes nextLAB Mobile as a configurable production dailies system that combines calibrated hardware, RAW playback and media management.
FotoKem presents its in-house nextLAB software as part of production workstations and names Frames separately as its iOS app.

limitation: The bundled nextLAB Mobile executable's release and architecture are undocumented in the public materials.
notes: This is the workstation-side software from FotoKem's dailies platform.

name: PdaNet for Android
product: PdaNet for Android, the macOS Wi-Fi Direct client by June Fabrics Technology Inc.

evidence.says: June Fabrics identifies the 5.24 Mac App Store client as Wi-Fi Direct only and lists older, separate downloads for USB tethering.
Apple’s live catalog lookup returns zero results for the exact Mac App Store item linked by June Fabrics.
The App Store record preserved by MacUpdater identifies bundle com.jftech.pdanet, lists version 5.24.2 on December 21, 2020, and reports Intel architecture.

limitation: The exact 5.24.2 app was unavailable in the US, UK and Canadian stores checked, and no vendor end-of-life date was found.
notes: The discontinued listing is for the Mac Wi-Fi Direct client. June Fabrics still publishes older USB installers and Android packages separately.

name: iVI 4
product: iVI 4 Mac App Store video converter by South Pole Software (Geoff Barrall)

evidence.says: The preserved Mac App Store metadata identifies the iVI 4 entry as item 1221678819 and lists release 4.754.
Apple’s live catalog lookup returns zero results for the exact iVI 4 item in the US storefront.
The preserved iVI 4 listing identifies Geoff Barrall as developer and links to the same Mac App Store item.

limitation: The exact App Store item was unavailable in the US, UK, Canadian and German stores checked, and the final release’s binary architecture and release date were not established.
notes: iVI Pro 4 and iVI 5 have separate distribution records.

name: Wire
product: Wire Secure Messenger for macOS by Wire Swiss GmbH

evidence.says: Apple's live Mac App Store metadata gives version 3.46.5500, its November 2, 2026 release date and the exact listing bundle ID.
The vendor's macOS build code at the 3.46.5500 release tag defaults the matching Wire bundle to the universal architecture.
The vendor's tagged release pipeline checks and packages the universal Wire Mac App Store build.

notes: The version is confirmed for the Mac App Store channel. The GitHub release title says 3.45.5500, while its tag and Apple's metadata say 3.46.5500.

name: Better Rename 10
product: Better Rename 10 Mac App Store edition by publicspace.net (Frank Reiff)

evidence.says: The developer says maintenance of the version 10 branch ended after the 10.46 direct-distribution release and identifies version 12 as current.
The developer explains the different names of its Mac App Store and direct editions and identifies the current store product as the Better Rename subscription.
The archived scan metadata identifies the listed App Store bundle as Better Rename 10 version 10.46.1.

limitation: The scanned 10.46.1 release was reported non-native. The final App Store build and its architecture could not be independently verified.
notes: The 2019 date on the direct edition's 10.46 release does not establish the date of the App Store 10.46.1 build.

name: Spdpd Dpdassistant
product: 大拍档剪辑助手 (Video Editing Assistant) by 视频大拍档

evidence.says: The developer lists 0.4.5 as current, names a separate arm64 Mac disk image in the release metadata, and offers cloud mirror links.
The historical download page also identifies a separate M1 build of version 0.4.5.

limitation: The direct official arm64 installer now returns 404, and current access to the matching build through the vendor's cloud mirrors could not be verified.
notes: The supplied aDrive and Alipay Key Tool casks are unrelated.

name: Scratch 3
product: Scratch 3 Desktop by the Scratch Foundation

evidence.says: The Scratch Foundation identifies 3.32.1 as the August 12, 2026 re-release of 3.32.0.
The Foundation's macOS build wrapper immediately before the release targets both arm64 and x86-64 for its macOS distribution builds.
The Foundation's macOS release pipeline publishes the Mac App Store package from its universal build directory.

limitation: The build configuration establishes the intended universal release, but the published 3.32.1 executable was not inspected.

name: CHITUBOX
product: Legacy CHITUBOX Basic resin slicer by CBD-Tech (CHITUBOX)

evidence.says: The vendor's unified CHITUBOX release history says the Basic and Pro editions were merged into a new product that would receive future updates.
The legacy Basic release archive dates 2.3.1 to January 17, 2025 and lists separate Mac Arm and Intel installers for it.
The vendor identifies the older CHITUBOX 1.x free slicer generation as CHITUBOX Basic.

notes: The last distinct Basic build 2.3.1 was available natively for Apple Silicon. Later archive entry 3.3.0 links the merged app's 1.2.0 installer, and the unified successor has its own Apple Silicon release.

name: Transcriber
product: Transcriber speech annotation tool by the Transcriber project (Claude Barras and contributors)

evidence.says: The original Transcriber project says TranscriberAG superseded it.
The original project's release archive lists the 1.5.2 El Capitan image, uploaded March 1, 2017, as the newest Mac package.

limitation: The final archived El Capitan image's executable architecture was not verified.
notes: TranscriberAG and current apps also called Transcriber are separate products.

name: Sonarworks SoundID Listen
product: SoundID Listen desktop app by Sonarworks

evidence.says: The Sonarworks EULA identifies SoundID Listen as the desktop edition of the SoundID product.
Sonarworks's current Download Center lists other products and provides no SoundID Listen desktop installer.

limitation: A current desktop build, its architecture, and a formal end-of-life notice could not be verified.
notes: The current mobile SoundID app and the SoundID Reference calibration product have separate compatibility information.

name: Spoon CAST Converter
product: Spoon CAST Converter by KK Systems, as identified by the scanned bundle

evidence.says: The archived app metadata names KK Systems as the copyright holder and identifies the 0.1.1 bundle.

limitation: No vendor page, current official Mac download, or architecture statement was found for this bundle.

name: Papers Beta
product: ReadCube Papers 4 beta-channel build by Digital Science

evidence.says: The historical bundle metadata identifies com.ReadCube.PapersBeta as Papers Beta build 4.25.3-beta.6.
ReadCube calls Papers 4 its legacy desktop app and documents the separate supported Papers desktop distribution with an Apple Silicon installer.
The vendor’s current download center offers a Mac desktop app without a separately listed Papers 4 beta product.

notes: The scanned beta bundle belongs to an older test channel of the ReadCube reference manager. Current Papers Apple Silicon installers do not establish the architecture of Papers Beta.

name: Democracy3
product: Democracy 3 for macOS by Positech Games, with the original Mac port by Red Marble Games

evidence.says: GOG’s live catalog lists version 1.30.2 Final Update as the current Mac installer.
GOG's catalog history dates the Mac installer update to version 1.30.2 to September 7, 2018.
The historical scan of the matching version and bundle ID records 32-bit and 64-bit Intel Mach-O slices and no ARM slice.
A player reports the desktop edition running on macOS and lists an Apple M4 Pro with macOS 26.3.0 in the review hardware details.

limitation: The Apple Silicon runtime report covers the Steam copy, while the exact 1.30.2 version and date are for the GOG installer.

name: Dictionary
product: Dictionary, the built-in macOS app by Apple

evidence.says: Apple documents Dictionary as a built-in Mac application and includes the current macOS Golden Gate guide.
A macOS System Profiler report identifies the Apple-signed /System/Applications/Dictionary.app version 2.3.0 with architecture marker arch_arm_i64.
The macOSWorld authors list Dictionary 2.3.0 in their macOS Sequoia 15.2 test installation.
A maintained macOS setup guide records Dictionary.app’s exact platform signing ID com.apple.Dictionary and version 2.3.0.

limitation: The published architecture report verifies version 2.3.0 on Apple Silicon, and the exact binaries in the latest macOS updates were not inspected.
notes: Apple distributes and updates Dictionary with macOS.

name: AppsAnywhere
product: AppsAnywhere macOS Client by AppsAnywhere (formerly Software2)

evidence.says: AppsAnywhere identifies 2.3.0 as the current macOS client, released in April 2026.
The same release history documents updated AppsAnywhere branding and native Apple Silicon support in macOS client 1.6.0.
Inspection of Applications/AppsAnywhere/AppsAnywhere.app/Contents/MacOS/AppsAnywhere in the vendor package confirmed x86_64 and arm64 slices and bundle version 2.3.0.

notes: The current version uses bundle ID com.aa.uk.AppsAnywhere. The scanned Software2-era ID was com.s2.uk.AppsAnywhere. The vendor gives the release month without a day.

name: Smart Converter
product: Smart Converter by ShedWorx (Systemic Pty Ltd)

evidence.says: ShedWorx's Mac App Store listing confirms the current 3.1.6 release and documents Apple M1 optimization in earlier 3.1 releases.
Softpedia's tested product listing identifies the versioned SmartConverter-3.1.6.dmg as a Universal Binary.

limitation: The versioned architecture statement is from the independent test listing, and the official executable was not directly inspected.
